name: 32852-specdecode-8b-1gpu
architecture: dense decoder, Qwen3ForCausalLM, 36 layers, 8.2B params = 16.4 GB bf16; one-layer LlamaForCausalLMEagle3 draft head over the same hidden size
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1000, warmup 15%, bounded at 8000 requests
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape: 128 prompt tokens and 100 output tokens with zero variance, greedy decoding (temperature 0)
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant with a draft model, serving short fixed-length prompts to a thousand concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM source checkout at 527bcd14d46595b2bde9e48f3d2f10879623b891
# (`git describe`: v0.16.0rc0-54-g527bcd14d465) -- a commit, not a release wheel.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
# Must stay on one line: the engine's own config reader is a flat line reader that skips
# indented lines, so a block mapping here would drop the key and start without it.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "Tengyunw/qwen3_8b_eagle3", "num_speculative_tokens": 5}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 1024
# PINNED, not left to the default. guidellm drives the engine in-process through
# `AsyncLLMEngine.from_engine_args`, whose usage context is `UsageContext.ENGINE_CONTEXT`;
# that key is absent from `arg_utils.get_batch_defaults`'s table, so an unset value falls
# through to `SchedulerConfig.DEFAULT_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS = 2048`. The scheduler charges
# 1+num_speculative_tokens = 6 tokens per running request, so 2048 caps the decode batch at
# 341 and the declared 1000 streams never decode together. The source served over HTTP
# (`OPENAI_API_SERVER`, 8192 on a >=70 GiB non-A100 card), so 8192 is the author's regime, and
# 8192/6 = 1365 >= 1000 lets the declared concurrency through.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
# 0.80 rather than 0.85. The profiling pass exercises one draft token per request, while the run
# decodes 1000 requests with 5 each, so the run's memory peak at full batch sits well above the
# profiled one: 0.85 leaves only 12 GB outside the budget and the run would OOM. 0.80 leaves
# 16 GB and still sizes the KV pool for ~1240 requests of 240 tokens, above the 1000 we ask for.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.80
